details.publicNotes:
Crafted from the remnants of failed attempts to create foci for planar travel, attunement arsenals are hulking patchworks of magical foci that retain some of their teleportation enchantments. With their lingering magic, these creatures shunt their foes through space, either drawing them in close enough to smash over the head or subjecting them to the nauseating effects of random and unrefined teleportation. Attunement arsenals are typically found guarding their creators or keeping watch over precious belongings.

Although technically a sign of repeated failures, attunement arsenals represent a spellcaster's diligence in learning advanced forms of magic. Their creators often take as much pride in displaying them as warriors do in showing off their scars.

Cosmic Tuners

While an attunement arsenal typically consists of a conglomeration of crystals and exotic metals, it can take on a variety of shapes. It might look like a crystalline giant or beast, a walking ring of black stone, a colored lens that reflects scenes from other worlds, an inverted bell made of a green skymetal alloy, or an arrangement of glowing runes orbiting each other in a vaguely humanoid shape. Regardless of its shape, the arsenal is adorned with antennae that function as tuning forks, capturing the sound of the cosmic void.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 375/840/1,560 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning), armor (heavy), shield, perception item, skill items (Athletics, Stealth)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, constitution, elongating, energy resistant (spirit, vitality, void), metal, mirrored, music, sensory (darkvision), space, space shield, strength, sturdy, throwing, wild

description.value:
Trigger The attunement arsenal takes damage from a Strike with a metal weapon or an unarmed attack that is made of metal

Effect Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] takes @Damage[4d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] save).

Any time an attunement arsenal would be affected by an effect with the sonic trait, it loses any slowed condition it has and gains HP equal to half the damage the spell would have dealt. If the arsenal starts its turn in an area that deals sonic damage, it gains @Damage[2d8[healing]] HP. It doesn't gain these benefits from its own abilities.

When a spell with the teleportation trait is cast within 10 feet of the attunement arsenal, the attunement arsenal is teleported up to 10 feet in a direction of the caster's choice and loses its resistance to physical damage for 1 round.

Requirements The attunement arsenal's last action was a successful syncopated slam Strike

Effect The attunement arsenal teleports to an open space within 10 feet of the target of its Strike.

The attunement arsenal's teleportation beam erratically relocates its targets. Due to the flaws in the foci that make up the arsenal's body, this teleportation is unsteady, making it stomach-churning to endure. A creature hit by a teleportation beam Strike must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save. This teleportation is forced movement. It can move targets into hazardous spaces, but it can't place them in occupied spaces or inside of a solid wall; if it would otherwise do so, it instead moves the target as far as it can in its randomly selected direction.

Critical Success The creature can teleport 5 feet in a direction of its choice.

Success The creature teleports 5 feet in a random direction.

Failure The creature teleports 15 feet in a random direction and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature teleports 30 feet in a random direction and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

The attunement arsenal creates a resounding clang with its fists, activating the planar-hopping items that make up its form and pulling nearby creatures into unstable portals. All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] take @Damage[5d8[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save). Creatures that critically fail are also teleported to an open space that is 10 feet closer to the attunement arsenal, or adjacent to the arsenal if they were less than 15 feet away; this is forced movement.
